ring_artifact_apply — TOMOGRAPHY artifact op

• Data kinds: sinogram → sinogram

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ring_artifact_apply(sinogram, gain_sigma=0.02, seed=0, offsets=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import tomography; tomography.ring_artifact_apply(sinogram, gain_sigma=0.02, seed=0, offsets=None), registry से लेना हो तो opstomography.get("ring_artifact_apply"))

उपयोग

detector को हर bin का gain error देता है — ring artefact का स्रोत।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

A detector bin whose gain is g reports I = g I_true, so after the logarithm the line integral picks up a constant offset -ln g at that bin, the same at every angle. Back-projecting a constant column smears it around the rotation axis, and the reconstruction grows a ring at the radius that bin's rays are tangent to. One bad pixel, one perfect circle.

The offsets are drawn once from N(0, gain_sigma) with a fixed *seed* and applied to every row, because the whole point is that the error does not vary with angle — that is what distinguishes a ring from noise, and what makes ring_artifact_remove possible.

:param sinogram: (n_angles, n_detectors). :param gain_sigma: standard deviation of the per-bin offset, >= 0. :param seed: RNG seed; there is no None (determinism is a contract here). :param offsets: explicit (n_detectors,) offsets; overrides the random draw. :returns: (n_angles, n_detectors) float64 sinogram. :raises ValueError: on a negative sigma, a non-int seed, or an *offsets* whose

length is not the detector count.
